title: Stmt-cache pre-encoded JSON column-name tokens
impact: Extends [exp 190](190-selectbytes-col-name-preencode.md)'s per-query token amortization across re-executions of the same prepared SQL by caching the encoded `"name":` / `,"name":` tokens on the `resqlite_cached_stmt` entry. Eliminates the per-query `buf_init(64)` + `free` pair and the first-row pre-encode walk from `write_json_to_buf`; the per-row loop is bit-identical to exp 190 and JSON output is byte-identical. Focused `select_bytes_repeated_calls.dart` 1-row × 20-col improves **−9.2 % / −7.2 %** and 10-row × 20-col improves **−5.1 % / −2.7 %** across two order-flipped passes, while 100/1000-row guards show sign reversal (drift-suspected — per-query setup is < 0.2 % of wall at those sizes). Exp 190's `wide_cols.dart` shapes trend candidate-faster on every 10k-row lane across both passes. No public API change, ~hundreds of bytes per cached statement
